Definition: What proportion of the population does the register cover?
Comments: Birth registration completeness 87.3% (2012), 87.6% (2000); proxy for CR uptake.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Sources corroborate the cited figure (87.3% birth registration completeness, DHS 2012) and confirm no newer survey exists — a 2022 UNICEF/Africa regional brochure still cites DHS 2012 as the latest data point for Comoros. However 87.3% falls in the 70-89% band, not >89%: the original Value Code 5 misapplies the metadata scale to its own cited evidence. Revised to 4 (70-89%).

Definition: Is the register integrated with the national ID system?
Comments: Electoral registration uses biometric national ID card; voter card may contain biometrics; partial/full integration implied.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: The 2023 Code électoral (verified directly) only establishes that the fichier électoral is 'informatisée et centralisée'; it makes no reference to the national ID system. UNDP and IDEA/CENI sources confirm the electoral roll is built from its own independent biometric enrolment kits (fingerprints, photo) and a dedicated processing centre (CNTDE), separate from the national digital ID card (2014 law, digitised by 2024 decree, produced by GenKey since 2026). No source demonstrates technical linkage between the two systems; the original comment's claim of integration was speculative ('may contain', 'implied'), not evidenced. Revised to 1 (No).

Definition: What proportion of the electorate does the register cover?
Comments: 70% of voting age citizens registered in 2015 biometric register used in elections.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Fresher data found: 338,940 registered voters as of January 2024 (IFES Election Guide; corroborated by Hogan Lovells Elections Hub and the EASF-SEOM 2025 observation report) against a population of roughly 837,000-865,000 (2022-24). This implies eligible-voter coverage broadly consistent with the 70-89% band originally cited for 2015. Value Code 4 confirmed, though the precise voting-age-population denominator is not separately published, so this remains an approximate estimate rather than a precisely sourced percentage.

Definition: Does the government maintain one or more social protection registers?
Comments: Social registry under development per World Bank Social Safety Net Project (delays, institutional framework targeted June 2021); MIS beneficiary registry for project at 100% for participants.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: World Bank reporting from September 2023 confirms the Ministry of Health, Solidarity, Social Protection and Gender Promotion 'has developed a beneficiary registry' covering over 36,000 vulnerable households under the Social Safety Net Project, now scaled up via the $30m Shock-Responsive and Resilient Social Safety Net Project (2023). This is a programme-specific registry that is operational, not merely 'under development' as the 2021 source stated; a 2025 industry commentary confirms Comoros still lacks a unified national social security registry. Revised to 4 (Partially deployed) — deployed for safety-net beneficiaries but not yet a unified nationwide social protection register.
